name: Sushi Roll
summary: Dice-drafting version of Sushi Go where players pick sushi dice from rotating conveyor belts over 3 rounds to score the most points.
rules_text: Game plays 3 rounds. Setup: each player gets a tray, 2 chopsticks and 3 menu tokens, plus a conveyor belt (one red-bordered). Fill each conveyor belt with a number of dice from the bag based on player count. Each round: players roll all dice on their conveyor, placing them back with faces unchanged. The red-belt player starts. On your turn you may spend tokens: menu (return 1 to reroll any dice on your belt) and chopsticks (return 1 to swap 1 die on your belt with 1 die on any opponent's belt). Then you must take 1 die from your belt to your tray; if it shows pudding, menu or chopsticks you gain matching tokens. If you take nigiri and you have an unused wasabi in your tray, you must stack it tripling the nigiri. After all players have taken one die, pass each belt left, reroll all dice received, and new red-belt holder starts. When belts empty, score dumpling, tempura, sashimi, maki majority, nigiri/wasabi for the round. After 3 rounds score pudding majority/minority and 1 point per 2 leftover tokens. Highest total wins.
